text:
miguel: quick round — did a screenreader pass on the Routes table in Console. major flow is fine but a few contrast/focus/keyboard nits.

sara: thanks! which exact page and what did you notice?

miguel: Console > Routes > Details (new table layout). main issues i flagged:
- focus ring for row selection is very thin and low-contrast (looks like 1px).
- status badges (warning/info) fall under ~2.5:1 on the gray background.
- keyboard nav: left/right arrows don't move between interactive cells, only up/down moves rows.
- row action menu has `aria-haspopup` but never toggles `aria-expanded` on open/close.

sara: ouch. any quick CSS or aria suggestions?

miguel: yep, sketch below — uses tokens where possible: 
```css
.tr-row:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus-strong); outline-offset: 2px; }
.badge--warning { background: var(--bg-warning); color: var(--fg-warning); }
```
Also: add `tabindex="0"` on the cells that should be keyboard-focusable and ensure the action button flips `aria-expanded="true"` when open.

liz: POV from VoiceOver: when using rotor/left-right to move between table cells, header labels aren't announced for each cell. we should ensure header cells have `scope="col"` or use `aria-labelledby` per cell if layout is non-semantic.

jon: cautious flag — let's avoid hard hex tokens to not break themes. prefer swapping to tokens e.g. `--color-focus-strong` instead of `#2563eb`.

miguel: agreed. i'll author a tiny PR that defines the token and maps it to the stronger value for the default theme. will include suggestions for badge token improvements.

a11y-bot: Automated checklist run — contrast failures: 2 (status badges); focus-size: fail (focus outline < 2px or insufficient contrast); missing aria-expanded on 1 element. Full report: https://a11y.example/reports/1852104321

sara: sounds good. assigning to @miguel for the changes. @jon please chime on token naming in the PR.

jon: will review tomorrow morning, thanks.

miguel: quick follow-ups — keyboard semantics: `Enter` should open the action menu, `Esc` should close. consider `aria-roledescription="row"` for custom row constructs so SRs announce row semantics consistently.

sara: tiny test ask: can you add an e2e that verifies focus ring remains visible at 200% zoom and a unit test that token fallback exists?

miguel: yep — adding a `console-e2e` focus test and a `tokens.test.ts` check. will ping channel with PR link when ready :thumbsup:

sara: perfect, thanks all!
